title: Product Review: Golden Gate Depot HO Scale Southern Pacific Interurban "Subs"
description:
Product Review: Golden Gate Depot HO Scale Southern Pacific Interurban "Subs". Released in July 2026, these are great cars that represent the 72-IC-1/2 Coach, 75-CS Lounge, 77-D-3/4 Diner, and 72-O-1 Observation.

A special thanks to San Francisco Vintage Photos group on Facebook for allowing me to use their photos for the history portion of the video.
